ruleReferences.usedFor: Official Pikachu Charge-Up Dash: flip until actual tails; choose own Basic Lightning Energy up to heads, attach to this Pokemon, then shuffle the deck.
Resolve text in order with server-owned randomness and actual self target. Printed until-tails has no 20-flip limit; one batch search/attachment has one final shuffle.

evidence.name: Charge-Up Dash
evidence.textEn: Flip a coin until you get tails. Search your deck for an amount of Basic <sprite name="lightning" tint=1> Energy up to the number of heads and attach it to this Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.
evidence.textZh: 抛掷硬币直到出现反面，选择自己牌库中最多与出现正面次数相同数量的「基本<sprite name="lightning" tint=1>能量」，附着于这只宝可梦身上。并重洗牌库。
